title: 'No double standards on terror': PM Modi's message at SCO in presence of Pak PM
content: Prime Minister Modi urged dismantling terrorism's entire ecosystem at the SCO Summit. He stressed that terrorism cannot be a strategic asset for any nation. Conflicts in West Asia impact global energy security and trade routes. India advocates for dialogue and diplomacy to resolve international tensions. The Prime Minister also highlighted drug trafficking as a serious regional threat.

title: Mahela Jayawardene likely to continue as MI coach; status quo on trade chatter
content: Mahela Jayawardene is likely to continue as Mumbai Indians head coach for IPL 2027, with the franchise preferring continuity despite a disappointing 2026 season. While Hardik Pandya's future remains a major talking point, MI are keen to retain him as a player, with Tilak Varma emerging as the frontrunner to take over the captaincy armband.

title: Cheeni Kum? Imported sugar is yet to land, so why is it getting cheaper
content: Sugar prices have surged notably, straining household budgets throughout India. This dramatic increase is attributed to lower domestic production coupled with heightened festive demand. Although government actions, such as permitting duty-free imports and implementing stock limits, have helped reduce mill gate prices, retail prices still soar as adjustments trickle through the supply chain. Looking ahead, improving future crushing seasons and imports should enhance sugar availability.

title: Musk's $60B purchase of Cursor that made Sam Altman 'upset' has an 'indian connection'
content: Elon Musk's SpaceX recently acquired the AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion.  This significant deal has brought co-founder Aman Sanger and his Indian family roots into focus.  Sanger, an MIT graduate, co-founded Cursor in 2022, which quickly achieved substantial growth.  The acquisition reportedly granted its founders billions in SpaceX shares.  This event also adds a new dimension to Musk's rivalry with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

title: 'Good for nothing': Kaneria lambasts Pak cricket, calls it 'a shame after 70 years'
content: Former Pakistan spinner Danish Kaneria slammed the country’s cricket system after a 0-2 Test series defeat to England. He criticised selection, coaching, domestic cricket and PCB accountability, arguing that personnel changes alone will not fix deeper issues. Kaneria called for structural reforms, a stronger domestic system, experienced coaches and selectors, and greater accountability to restore Pakistan’s competitive spirit.

title: ‘This is the reason they are in mess’: Ex-Pakistan coach tears into PCB
content: Mickey Arthur, the former coach of the Pakistan cricket team, expresses his disappointment in the Pakistan Cricket Board's hasty decisions following a series of Test losses. After sending seven players packing and altering the coaching setup, Arthur argues that such frequent changes hinder team stabilization and undermine performance consistency. With the addition of debutants among the replacements, Pakistan now faces a challenging position at the World Test Championship.

title: Melinda Gates took $12.5 billion; here’s where she’s spending it
content: Melinda French Gates has taken the reins of $12.5 billion independently, moving on from her tenure at the Gates Foundation. With a keen eye on issues often overlooked, she emphasizes the importance of supporting women and girls worldwide. By focusing on fundamental areas like childcare systems and menopause studies, her mission champions long-lasting change instead of merely backing widely recognized causes.

title: Nepal tragedy: Owners missing, dog refuses to leave flood-hit Trishuli home
content: A black-and-white dog remains at the site of four homes destroyed by a flood.  He refuses to leave the muddy patch where his home once stood.  Rescue workers and JCBs clear debris around the steadfast canine.  Volunteers offer food and water, which he accepts quietly when alone.  Displaced residents understand his loyalty to his former territory.

title: 95-year-old Florida clock gets 700-hour restoration after decades outdoors
content: In Clearwater, Florida, a remarkable four-faced clock has undergone an impressive restoration, thanks to clockmaker David H. Boyd, who dedicated 700 hours to the project. He skillfully preserved the original dial and hands while integrating new clockworks. This iconic timepiece now proudly graces Cleveland Street again, bridging the city’s rich history with contemporary usability.

title: Mark Zuckerberg buys 440-acre Irish castle estate; spokesperson says family is ‘excited’
content: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his spouse Priscilla Chan have acquired the majestic Strancally Castle in County Waterford, Ireland. Spanning around 440 acres, the estate boasts a rich history dating back to 1830. The couple intends to use this beautifully restored property as a retreat during their visits, reinforcing Meta's strong ties to Ireland, where the company has its international headquarters.

title: India eyes drones that helicopters can launch, control and send 80km into enemy territory
content: Helicopter-launched munitions are rapidly advancing aerial warfare capabilities globally. India is developing similar systems for its air force and transport aircraft. These systems offer enhanced strike and surveillance options for military operations. Other nations like the United States and China are also pursuing these technologies. Such air-deployable munitions are poised to become a standard military doctrine.

title: September 2 birthday personality: Traits and life lesson; hidden strengths explained
content: Individuals born on September 2 possess an exceptional ability to read between the lines and showcase impressive diplomatic talents. Their keen emotional insight allows them to grasp unspoken needs effortlessly, making them supportive companions at work and in friendships. title: How teen's plea for help after tiff with parents ended in gangrape on moving bus
content: A 17-year-old girl seeking help after leaving home was gang-raped on a moving sleeper bus.  Two men offered her a ride, then sexually assaulted her for about thirty kilometers.  They abandoned the teenager near Kashmere Gate after the alleged crime.  Police arrested the driver and conductor within hours of the complaint being filed.  The incident raises safety concerns for passengers on private buses.

title: Nepal issues fresh flood alert as water levels rise; death toll surpasses 1,000
content: The border between Nepal and China is reeling from catastrophic flash floods that have claimed more than a thousand lives. Rescue teams are in a race against time, searching for hundreds of individuals still unaccounted for, many of whom may be trapped in hydropower tunnels. The disaster was triggered by a sudden glacial collapse, leading to a devastating surge of water and debris that has obliterated key infrastructure.

One victim was thrown nearly five feet into the air by the severe impact. The accused driver, identified as Deepu, was arrested by police on Monday. Two diesel dispensing machines at the petrol pump also sustained damage.

Prema Devi, her son Manish, and daughter Kalpana lost their lives during the disaster that occurred after a night of intense rainfall. Despite prompt rescue efforts, the team could only recover their bodies, marking a somber day for the neighborhood.

title: Chenab river water level rises in J&K’s Reasi as Salal Dam opens 4 gates
content: The Chenab river's water level rose in Reasi district on Tuesday. Authorities opened four gates of the Salal Dam to manage increased reservoir inflow. This action followed continuous rainfall in the upper catchment areas of the region. Water is now being released downstream in a controlled and regulated manner. Officials are closely monitoring the reservoir's water level and inflow conditions.

title: ‘Pakistan was ruined’: Ex-cricketer blames Babar-Afridi rift for team’s downfall

Following a disastrous tour of England, the PCB has initiated major changes within the team. Several players and coaches have been removed as the board reassesses its strategy.

title: Earning Rs 10 lakh more in Bengaluru may not mean saving more, thanks to high costs
content: Bengaluru’s higher salaries may look attractive to professionals considering relocation, but rising living costs can significantly reduce their actual savings. A tech professional’s comparison of Bengaluru, Delhi, Noida and Gurugram highlights expenses such as rent, food, commuting and travel home. The analysis underscores why employees should assess their net financial gains before switching cities for better pay.

title: 11 weapons, including AK-203, pistols stolen from high-security Secunderabad Cantonment

The theft occurred Sunday night in the Secunderabad Cantonment, prompting an immediate investigation.  Army officials sealed the entire area after discovering the sophisticated weapons were missing.  Initial findings suggest an insider may have been involved in the security breach.  Police are questioning individuals associated with the military wing and civilian units.

Osaka said she admired Iverson’s influence on sports fashion. She then defeated Anastasia Zakharova in straight sets and advanced to the second round against Katerina Siniakova.

title: Tunnels and tough terrain: Indian Army joins Nepal's flood rescue effort

The joint teams probed into tunnels, carefully searching unstable areas. This deployment followed Nepal's request for specialized personnel trained for such missions. India and Nepal have a history of coordinating disaster response efforts.

The accused woman was apprehended and joined the ongoing police investigation.
